verdict.rationale: Datalab's Mintlify-based API reference runs an interactive playground with a per-endpoint "Try it" runner that calls the live API with the user's key. It is backed by reference pages for convert, extract, segment, agent and health endpoints and an OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec. The 404s on the docs domain do not contradict this, because the spec is served from the main domain. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation that the runner works, and documented copy-paste code samples per language alongside the runner.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Mintlify API reference runs the interactive playground ("playground":{"display":"interactive"}) with a "Try it" runner per endpoint.
The playground is client-rendered and targets the live API with the user's key.
Datalab serves its OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (info title "Datalab API") from its main domain
